extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from local XML/PDF/OA evidence; no direct molecular target is promoted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports phenotypic antimicrobial activity for the three amidated moronecidin-family peptides through MIC tables across bacteria and yeasts.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MIC/activity tables establish phenotype and condition sensitivity, not a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports condition-dependent salt sensitivity, especially loss of activity at higher divalent cation concentrations for some peptide/condition pairs.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: moro-NH2, moroNC-NH2, and moroPC-NH2 against Psychrobacter sp. PAMC 25501
mechanism_claims.limitations: Salt sensitivity is a functional context, not a direct membrane mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports lower hemolytic toxicity for the Antarctic fish peptides than the moronecidin control under the tested erythrocyte assay.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: moroNC-NH2 and moroPC-NH2 compared with moro-NH2
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-derived exact hemolysis percentages are not all tabulated in text; exact database graph values are preserved as cautions when not source-tabulated.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The helical wheel and physicochemical analysis provide amphipathic alpha-helical context for the peptides.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: moro, moroNC, and moroPC mature peptides
